name: discord
description: Discord bot — accounts, conversation, images in and out, and voice channels on Sapphire's conversation engine. Chat, greetings and voice are daemon tasks (Discord: Chat only / Greetings / All interactions; Realtime: Discord: Voice channel); personality modules live in the discord-personality plugin.
author: zeebie-the-zebra

event_sources.name: discord_message
event_sources.label: Discord: Chat only
event_sources.description: Replies to messages on the selected bot (filters below). This task's provider, persona, toolset and scopes are the brain.

task_fields.label: Bot Account
task_fields.help: Which Discord bot this daemon listens on. Only bots selected by an enabled daemon task are connected.

task_fields.label: Auto-reply in channel
task_fields.help: ON (default): AI's response posts back to the channel. OFF: listen-only mode.

event_sources.name: discord_greetings
event_sources.label: Discord: Greetings
event_sources.description: Daily good-morning / goodnight posts written by this task (its Instructions set the tone). No message replies. One post per channel per day.

task_fields.label: Bot Account
task_fields.help: Which Discord bot this daemon listens on. Only bots selected by an enabled daemon task are connected.

task_fields.label: Channels (ids, comma-separated)
task_fields.help: Text channel ids the daily posts go to. In Discord: Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode, then right-click a channel → Copy Channel ID.

task_fields.label: Good-morning time
task_fields.help: Local HH:MM. Blank = no morning post. Fires once per channel per day inside a five-minute window after the time; a late boot never greets.

task_fields.label: Goodnight time
task_fields.help: Local HH:MM. Blank = no goodnight post.

event_sources.name: discord_voice
event_sources.label: Discord: Voice channel
event_sources.description: Gate: an enabled rule turns voice ON for the channels its filter covers (no filter = every voice channel the bot can see). She joins on /voice join or her join tool — or on her own when Auto-join is on and someone is in the channel — converses live on Sapphire's conversation engine (this rule's persona, provider, model and toolset configure the voice chat), and leaves on <<HANG UP>>, /voice leave, or when the channel empties. Never fires a one-shot reply.

task_fields.label: Auto-join when someone is in the channel
task_fields.help: OFF (default): she only joins when asked (/voice join, her join tool). ON: she walks into a covered channel when a human is there and leaves when it empties. A channel she left on purpose (<<HANG UP>>, /voice leave) is not rejoined until it has emptied once.

task_fields.label: Keep voice chat history
task_fields.help: OFF (default): each channel's voice chat is deleted 30 minutes after her last session there (strangers' transcripts don't pile up). ON: the chat persists.

schedule.name: retention_purge
schedule.description: Daily purge of plugin data older than the Retention day limits

settings.label: LLM debug ring
settings.help: Keep the last 10 prompts and replies in memory for the Debug panel — full prompts, other people's messages included. Off = nothing retained. Clear it from the panel any time.

settings.label: Reply mode
settings.help: First gate before the LLM. Mentions only is the usual choice for public servers. Default also rolls Human/Bot organic reply chance on unaddressed channel messages.

options.label: Default — reply when addressed, plus organic chance
Mentions only — require @mention or name match
Reply to all — answer every allowed message

settings.label: Human organic reply chance (%)
settings.help: In Default reply mode only: percent chance (0-100) to reply to a human message that did not address her (@mention / name match). Mentions and DMs always reply. 0 = never chime in unprompted.

settings.label: Bot organic reply chance (%)
settings.help: In Default reply mode only: percent chance (0-100) to reply to an eligible bot message that did not address her. Still requires Bot-to-bot replies and allowlist/mode gates. Mentions bypass this roll. 0 = never.

settings.label: Respond to bot name (soft mention)
settings.help: Reply when a message contains the bot's name anywhere in the text, no @mention needed. OFF (default): only real @mentions count.

settings.label: Case-sensitive name match
settings.help: ON: the name must match capitalization exactly. OFF (default): any capitalization counts. Only applies when name match is on.

settings.label: Batch window (seconds)
settings.help: Collect rapid messages into one reply. Typing extends; questions halve.

settings.label: Strip thinking tags
settings.help: ON (default): removes <think> reasoning blocks from replies before posting. OFF: raw thinking text posts to the channel.

settings.label: Typing indicator
settings.help: ON (default): shows typing… before each message, paced like a human typing the reply (roughly 0.5-12 seconds by length). OFF: posts instantly with no indicator.

settings.label: Human pause
settings.help: Brief pause before sending, scaled to reply length.

settings.label: Read delay
settings.help: Wait as if reading the message before typing starts.

settings.label: Bot-to-bot replies
settings.help: ON (default): messages from bots in the Allowlisted Bots list are treated like anyone else's — a mention gets a reply, the rest roll the bot organic chance; after 5 bot-triggered replies in a row in one channel she waits for a human to speak. OFF: bot messages are always ignored.

settings.label: LLM reaction tags
settings.help: ON (default): a [react:emoji] tag she writes into a reply lands as a reaction on the message she answered. OFF: the tag is stripped and ignored.

settings.label: Autonomous silent reactions
settings.help: React with an emoji without replying — one roll per message she reads; the emoji follows the message's tone (a small word list, no model).

settings.label: Reaction chance (%)
settings.help: Chance (0-100%) she silently reacts to a message she reads. 0 = never.

settings.label: Reaction cooldown (seconds)
settings.help: Minimum seconds between her self-initiated reactions in the same channel. 0 = no cooldown.

settings.label: Allow DMs
settings.help: OFF (default): she won't reply to direct messages — anyone who shares a server can DM a bot, so it is an outside line until you open it. ON: she replies to DMs (they are stored in the plugin database; scheduled reminders she owes someone may still deliver by DM).

settings.label: DM budget per person per day
settings.help: When DMs are on: how many DM messages from one person she answers per day before going quiet on them until tomorrow. 0 = unlimited.

settings.label: Tools stay in the server
settings.help: ON (default): while she is replying inside a Discord server, her Discord tools can only read or post in THAT server — a message in one server can't make her post into another, or into someone's DMs. From your own chats she can reach any channel. OFF: no reach limit inside events.

settings.label: Reply cooldown (seconds)
settings.help: Minimum seconds between replies in the same channel, DMs included (default 30). 0 = no limit. This is the only throttle on the reply pipeline.

settings.label: Proactive cooldown (hours)
settings.help: Minimum hours between proactive posts of the same kind (greeting, outreach, goodnight, birthday) in one channel. Reminder and commitment follow-ups bypass this.

settings.label: Quiet hours
settings.help: Presence only: during the quiet window her status switches to the Quiet / sleep status. Replies and proactive posts still send — use the Sleep schedule to actually go quiet.

settings.label: Quiet start (server local hour)
settings.help: Hour (0-23, server local) quiet hours begin. Start later than end wraps past midnight; start equal to end disables.

settings.label: Quiet end (server local hour)
settings.help: Hour (0-23, server local) quiet hours end. Example: start 22, end 7 covers overnight.

settings.label: Images in
settings.help: ON: images posted in chat ride into her reply as pictures when the daemon task's model can see images (fetched off the gateway, 10 MB each, no captioning). OFF (default): attachments are ignored. Does not affect GIF replies.

settings.label: Max images per message
settings.help: How many of one message's images she gets to see.

settings.label: GIF replies
settings.help: ON: she can reply with real GIFs — she writes [gif:search terms] or calls the send-GIF tool and it's swapped for a GIF from your provider. Requires a GIF API key.

settings.label: GIF API key
settings.help: API key for the selected GIF provider. GIF replies stay off until this is set, even with the toggle on.

settings.label: GIF provider
settings.help: Which service her GIF searches use: Klipy, Giphy, or Tenor. The API key must match the provider.

settings.label: GIF content filter
settings.help: Safety level for GIF search results: Off (unfiltered) to High (strictest). Applies the same direction on Klipy, Giphy, and Tenor.

settings.label: Turn cues
settings.help: Tick while she thinks, ding on barge-in

settings.label: Min silence (seconds)
settings.help: Silence that ends an utterance before it is transcribed (seconds).

settings.label: Addressing: mode
settings.help: When she treats speech as meant for her

settings.label: Addressing: name aliases
settings.help: Extra names that count as hers (sapph, saphire...)

settings.label: Addressing: alone = no name needed
settings.help: One person in the channel with her: everything said is for her

settings.label: Addressing: follow-up window (seconds)
settings.help: After she answers someone, that person can keep talking without her name for this long. Others still need it. 0 = off

settings.label: Barge-in: hold (ms)
settings.help: How long you must keep talking over her before she stops. A click or thump can't hold this long; a word can

settings.label: Retention purge
settings.help: OFF (default): nothing is ever purged. ON: a daily purge (4:30 AM server time) deletes plugin rows older than the day limits below — enabling this is a conscious choice; the first run on a long-lived database deletes everything beyond the windows.

settings.label: Keep messages (days)
settings.help: Purge deletes the plugin's stored copies of Discord messages older than this many days (default 90). 0 = keep forever. Nothing is deleted on Discord itself.

settings.label: Keep traces (days)
settings.help: Purge deletes decision traces (the Traces view) older than this many days (default 14). 0 = keep forever.

settings.label: Keep transcripts (days)
settings.help: Purge deletes voice-channel transcripts older than this many days (default 30). 0 = keep forever.
